summary: Buddie — AI Agent Reliability Toolkit: canonical Discovery packaging and consistent README-style branding.
changes: The compact Claude plugin includes the canonical Buddie Discovery skill and reporting reference, read from the release commit and relocated without changing their bytes.
Discovery distinguishes real Core verification, independent evidence triage with authorized tools, and unverified claims when relevant tools are unavailable.
Public manifests and generated package descriptions adopt the AI Agent Reliability Toolkit positioning and the existing Verify the claim. Know the context. tagline.
The plugin and Desktop bundle use the previously created white-dog icon with cyan accents matching the README artwork.
Packaging rejects missing Discovery dependencies and competing destination paths, including case variants on Windows.
Worker lifecycle tests retain diagnostics and clean up surviving workers; the historical Linux failure is not claimed resolved by Discovery packaging.
upgrade: Install buddie==2.0.3 or use the matching approved plugin or Desktop bundle. The canonical standalone Discovery skill has its own 0.1.0 version. Existing 2.0.2 artifacts remain unchanged.
permissions: No new Core runtime permissions are required. Discovery uses only tools and evidence already authorized in the host session; optional Core diagnostics retain existing permission grants. No automatic installation or credential access is added.
security: The candidate binds runtime archives, public metadata and the plugin's canonical-source mapping to its source revision and SHA-256 digests. Independent checks never fabricate Core receipts. Report vulnerabilities through SECURITY.md.
limitations: Discovery is an instruction skill, not an executable verifier. Automatic hooks and local MCP vary by client; actual Cowork, Claude Chat and mobile behavior is not certified by package validation. Projects/Context, hosted remote MCP and image-understanding tools are not introduced. Agensi submission is pending review, not approved.
